description: This file defines a React component called ProductsShop that connects to a Redux store to display a list of products, handle loading states, and show a not found message if no products are available.

classes.name: ProductsShop
classes.description: A React component that displays products, handles loading state, and shows a not found message when no products are available.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches products based on URL slug when the component mounts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the product list, loading indicator, or not found message based on current state and props.
